elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The cap applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is limited to fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months; there is no USD 1,000,000 floor or greater-of formulation.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Each Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations is expressly “not subject to any limitation.”

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No carve-out addresses data protection or security obligations.
Each Party's indemnification obligations are expressly “not subject to any limitation.”
Each Party's gross negligence is expressly “not subject to any limitation.”
Each Party's wilful misconduct is expressly “not subject to any limitation.”
Fraud is not included among the uncapped carve-outs.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
